ambiguity.prompt: Add optional service-fee support to total in billing.py.

minimal.prompt: Extend slugify in slugs.py so repeated whitespace becomes one hyphen and whitespace at either end is trimmed. Preserve punctuation and lowercase behavior. Unicode normalization and configurable separators are future backlog items, not part of this task.
minimal.oracle:
from slugs import slugify
assert slugify("  Hello   World  ") == "hello-world"
assert slugify("A\tB\nC") == "a-b-c"
assert slugify(" Hi, There! ") == "hi,-there!"
assert slugify("") == ""
assert slugify("   ") == ""
